newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ABS-CBN expects profits on track by Q3.
newsitem.headline: ABS-CBN expects profits on track by Q3.

text.p: The Philippine's biggest broadcasting company, ABS-CBN Broadcasting Corp, said it expects to meet earnings target for the year despite lower net in the first quarter due to a row with advertisers.
"We will be back on track by August or September," ABS-CBN president Eugenio Lopez III told reporters on Saturday.
ABS-CBN earlier reported a first quarter net income of 248 million pesos, lower than the adjusted figure of 291 million in the year-earlier period.
It said that cancellation by advertisers of orders in protest over a decision to raise prime time rates hit company earnings in the first three months of the year.
Lopez said the issue with advertisers has since been settled and he remains confident of ABS-CBN achieving full-year targets.
The company is expected to make 1.8 billion pesos in profits this year from 1.53 billion pesos in 1996.

Lopez said that the ABS-CBN is tapping overseas market with its all Filipino channel. He said ABS-CBN recently signed a memorandum of understanding with the Arab Radio and Television Network to carry the channel in the Middle East and in Europe.
